data.message: Individual opt-in, not an all-or-nothing deal: I commit to request 18 tons even if others choose 10. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 adds $8,000 if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). Even all 18 leaves 50, above the 25-ton collapse threshold, but recovery is not guaranteed. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation.
